newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France cargo traffic up 1.6pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Air France cargo traffic up 1.6pct in Jan.

text.p: Air France recorded a 1.6 percent increase in cargo traffic in January 1997, with 338.3 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), figures from the French national carrier show.
The overall cargo load factor in January 1996 was up 2.3 percentange points on the same month the previous year at 66.6 percent, the airline said.
In the first ten months of its current financial year (April-March) Air France transported 4.02 billion FTK, up 5.9 percent on April 1995-January 1996.

Overall cargo load factor during April 1996-January 1997 was up 0.6 percentage points on the same period the previous year at 68.5 percent, Air France said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
